# Synthetic Failure Case: Missing Background, Significance, And References

This fixture is invented for regression testing. It does not contain private
application text.

## Expected Audit Results

- Structural Completeness Verdict: FAIL
- Missing or weak background
- Missing overall significance
- Missing human-health or societal relevance
- Inadequate literature anchoring
- Recommendation to add or integrate significance content

## Proposal Text

### Title

Adaptive sensor grids for drought-resilient urban trees

### Overall Goal

This project will build three complementary tools for monitoring urban trees.

### Aim 1

Develop a low-power distributed sensor package for root-zone moisture dynamics.

### Aim 2

Create a predictive model for irrigation timing across heterogeneous street
conditions.

### Aim 3

Build a dashboard that helps municipal teams prioritize maintenance.

The aims are distinct and technically coherent. The proposal assumes reviewers
already know why urban-tree water stress is a major problem, what is known about
root-zone sensing, what gap remains, why that gap matters, and which prior work
supports the rationale.
